name: pg_backend_pid() Implementation
description: Implement pg_backend_pid() function to return a unique connection identifier for ORM compatibility and connection health checks

userStories.title: Add connection ID to DynamicPgHandler
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a unique connection ID generated per connection so that pg_backend_pid() can return it.
acceptanceCriteria: Generate connection ID in DynamicPgHandler::new() using atomic counter
Store connection_id as i32 field in DynamicPgHandler struct
Connection ID remains stable for the lifetime of the connection
Different connections get different IDs
cargo build succeeds
cargo test passes

userStories.title: Pass connection ID to executor context
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the connection ID accessible in the SQL executor so that pg_backend_pid() can retrieve it.
acceptanceCriteria: Add connection_id field to SqlSession or execution context
Pass connection_id from handler to executor when executing queries
cargo build succeeds
cargo test passes

userStories.title: Implement pg_backend_pid() function
userStories.description: As a user, I want SELECT pg_backend_pid() to return my connection ID so that ORMs and tools can use it for health checks and logging.
acceptanceCriteria: Add match case for 'pg_backend_pid' in expr.rs eval_function()
Returns Value::Int32 with the session's connection_id
No TiKV round-trip - pure in-memory operation
cargo build succeeds
cargo test passes

userStories.title: Add integration tests for pg_backend_pid()
userStories.description: As a developer, I need tests to verify pg_backend_pid() works correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: Add tests to tests/73_system_functions.sql (extend existing)
Test: SELECT pg_backend_pid() returns an integer
Test: SELECT pg_backend_pid() = pg_backend_pid() returns true (stable within session)
Create corresponding .expected file
./run_tests.sh passes (full integration + ORM tests)
